title: Scoutsuite: pyasn1 has quadratic-complexity denial of service in binary REAL decoding (CVE-2026-119197)
description: pyasn1 versions up to 0.6.4 have a denial of service vulnerability in the decoding of binary-encoded ASN.1 REAL values with large mantissas. The decoding process is quadratic in CPU time relative to mantissa length, causing high CPU usage and potential exhaustion. This affects BER, CER, and DER decoders using the RealPayloadDecoder. The issue is fixed in pyasn1 0.6.5 by optimizing the decoding loop.
